e.title: **一**篇**用**全**国**住**户**调**查**估**算**「**灾**难**性**医**疗**支**出」**的**论**文****：`catastrophic-health-expenditure-bangladesh`——**⭐ 逐字标题**为**「**Catastrophic health expenditures and medical impoverishment in Bangladesh: evidence from the Household Income and Expenditure Survey**」**；**⭐ 它**用**逐字 **`the well-known methodology developed by Wagstaff and Doorslaer`** 估**算 **CHE**，**并**逐字**用 **`a generalised linear model with a log link and a gamma distribution`** 做**回**归**；**⭐ 而**它**把**三**档**阈**值**并**排**报**出**（**逐字 **`17.72%`（**总**消费 **10%）／**`7.07%`（**25%）／**`9.46%`（**非**食品 **40%）**）**，**并**逐字**给**出**贫**困**化**人**数 **`3.7%`** of the population (`6.13 million people`)****
e.summary: **Catastrophic health expenditures and medical impoverishment in Bangladesh**（PMID `42711079`；*BMJ Open* 2026;16(9):e111600）**是一篇**用**全国**住户**调查**估**算**「**灾**难**性**医疗**支出」**的**论文****——**逐字标题**为**「**Catastrophic health expenditures and medical impoverishment in Bangladesh: evidence from the Household Income and Expenditure Survey**」**。**本次实测**：**⭐ 出**版日 **2026-09-08****（**窗口内）**、**期**刊**卷**期**逐字 **`2026 Sep 8;16(9):e111600`****、**DOI **`10.1136/bmjopen-2025-111600`****、**PMCID **`PMC13560981`****、**许可**逐字 **`CC BY-NC`****、**利**益**冲突**逐字 **`None declared`****；**⭐ 数据**逐字**为 **`the latest Household Income and Expenditure Survey 2022`**、**样本 **`14 395 households`／**`eight administrative divisions`****；**⭐ 方法**逐字**含 **`Wagstaff and Doorslaer`** 与 **`a generalised linear model with a log link and a gam ma distribution`****。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**新面 **PubMed（**健康**保险**线）**」**，**并**补上**本站**最薄的一栏**（**健康保险**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **它**把**同**一**个**指标**在**三**档**阈值**下**并**排**报**出**，**而**不**挑**一**个**好**看**的**报****——**⭐ 逐字**：**`The prevalence of CHE was estimated to be 17.72% (95% CI 17.71% to 17.73%) and 7.07% (95% CI 7.06% to 7.08%) using 10% and 25% of the total consumption expenditure as thresholds, respectively. Given the 40% of non-food expenditure threshold level, about 9.46% (95% CI 9.45% to 9.47%) of households faced CHE due to OOP expenditure in Bangladesh.`****——**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**对 **RIAA** 最有用**：**⭐ 即**「**灾**难**性**支出**的**发生率」**完**全**取**决**于**阈值**选择**（**10%** 总**消费** vs **25%** 总**消费** vs **40%** 非**食品**），**三**者**差**出**两**倍**以上**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**报**告**任**何**「**比例**型」**指标**时**，**把**不同**阈值**下**的**结果**并**排**列**出**，**而**不**要**只**报**一**个**（**⭐ 与**第 **380** 轮**记下的**「**估**不**了**的**参**数**在**网格**上**声明**」**同**属**「**把**口径**敏**感性**摆**到**台**面**上」）**；**② **它**用**的**回**归**分**布**选**择**有**讲**究**（**逐字**：**a generalised linear model with a log link and a gamma distribution）**——**⭐ 即**年**度**自**付**医**疗**支出**是**「**右偏**、**非**负、**连**续」**的**量**，**log **link ＋ **gamma** 是**保**险**与**卫**生**经**济**里**的**常**规**配**置**；**③ **它**同**时**报**「**发生**率」**与**「**贫**困**化」**两**个**不**同**的**后果****（**逐字**：**approximately 3.7% (95% CI 3.7% to 3.71%) of the population (6.13 million people) fell into poverty in Bangladesh**）**——**⭐ 即**「**有**多**少**人**遇**到**灾**难**性**支出」**与**「**有**多**少**人**因**此**跌**入**贫**困」**是**两**件**事**，**保**险**政**策**关**心**的**往**往**是**后**者**；**④ **它**的**结论**逐字**落**在**「**预**付**制」**上**（**逐字**：**Findings stress the need for prepayment schemes such as national health insurance for safeguarding households against falling into poverty.**）**。**⚠️ 本次**未读**其**正文**、**未**重**跑**其**估**算**。
e.body:
**Catastrophic health expenditures and medical impoverishment in Bangladesh**（PMID `42711079`；*BMJ Open* 2026;16(9):e111600）**是一篇**用**全国**住户**调查**估**算**「**灾**难**性**医疗**支出」**的**论文****——**逐字标题**为**「**Catastrophic health expenditures and medical impoverishment in Bangladesh: evidence from the Household Income and Expenditure Survey**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**新面 **PubMed（**健康**保险**线）**」**。
**可核实信息（均 2026-09-27 PubMed E-utilities 实测）**：
**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它**把**同**一**个**指标**在**三**档**阈值**下**并**排**报**出**，**而**不**挑**一**个**好**看**的**报****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**摘要**逐字**写**「**The prevalence of CHE was estimated to be 17.72% (95% CI 17.71% to 17.73%) and 7.07% (95% CI 7.06% to 7.08%) using 10% and 25% of the total consumption expenditure as thresholds, respectively. Given the 40% of non-food expenditure threshold level, about 9.46% (95% CI 9.45% to 9.47%) of households faced CHE due to OOP expenditure in Bangladesh.**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**对 **RIAA** 最有用**：**⭐ 即**「**灾**难**性**医疗**支出**发生率」**这**个**数**字**完**全**取**决**于**「**用**总**消费**的 **10%** 还**是 **25%**、**还**是**非**食品**支出**的 **40%」**——**⭐ 三**档**之**间**可**以**差**出**两**倍**以上**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**报**告**任**何**「**占比**型」**或**「**阈值**型」**指标**时**，**把**多**档**结**果**并**排**列**出**，**而**不**要**只**给**一**个**数**（**⭐ 与**第 **380** 轮**记下的**「**过**度**离**散**指**数**在 **1.10～**2.00** 网格**上**声明」**同**属**「**口**径**敏**感性**要**摆**到**台**面**上」）**。
**⭐⭐ ② 它**的**回归**分布**选**择**有**讲**究**，**并**且**是**保**险**与**卫**生**经**济**的**常**规**配**置****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**摘要**逐字**写**「**We used a generalised linear model with a log link and a gam ma distribution to assess the association between the explanatory variables and annual OOP expenditure.**」**（**⭐ 原**文**在**此**处**为 **`gam ma`，**即**排**版**时**的**词**内**空**格，**本**词条**照**录**而**不**静**默**修**正）**；**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**年**度**自**付**医疗**支出**是**「**右偏**、**非**负、**连**续」**的**量**，**用 **log **link＋**gamma** 而**不**是**线性**回归**是**因**为**前**者**兼**顾**「**乘**性**效**应」**与**「**正**值**约束」**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**做**赔付**或**支出**建模**时**，**先**看**分**布**形**状**再**选**连**接**函**数**（**⭐ 与**第 **380** 轮**记下的**「**残值**服**从 **Weibull」**同**属**「**分**布**形**状**决**定**模型」）**。
**⭐⭐ ③ 它**同时**报**「**发生**率」**与**「**贫**困**化」**两**个**不**同**的**后果****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**摘要**逐字**写**「**In 2022, approximately 3.7% (95% CI 3.7% to 3.71%) of the population (6.13 million people) fell into poverty in Bangladesh.**」**，**并**逐字**列**出**高**发**人**群**（**逐字**：**The prevalence of CHE was higher among male-headed households, larger families, households with elderly members, households with members suffering from chronic illnesses, those using hospital care and individuals in the poorest wealth quintiles.**）**；**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**「**有多少**户**遇到**灾难**性**支出」**与**「**有多少**人**因此**跌入**贫困」**是**两**件**事**——**⭐ 保**险**政**策**与**社**保**研究**关**心**的**通**常**是**后**者**（**⭐ 而**前**者**是**风**险**分**摊**的**中**间**指标）**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**写**健**康**险**或**社**保**作**业**时**，**把**「**发生率」**与**「**财务**后**果」**分**两**段**写**。
**⭐⭐ ④ 它**的**方法**与**数**据**逐字**可**追****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**摘要**逐字**写**「**The well-known methodology developed by Wagstaff and Doorslaer was used in this study to estimate the prevalence of CHE and the effect of OOP spending on impoverishment.**」**与**「**We used data from the latest Household Income and Expenditure Survey 2022 in Bangladesh.**」**与**「**14 395 households from eight administrative divisions in Bangladesh.**」**，**并**逐字**声**明**研**究**设**计**为 **`A national cross-sectional survey`****；**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**「**用**已**知**方**法**（**Wagstaff **- **Doorslaer）**＋**公**开**住**户**调查**＋**写**明**样本**量**与**分**区」**三**件**事**让**这**类**卫生**经济**估**算**可**被**追**溯**与**复**算**（**⭐ 本**词条**未**重**跑**）。
**⭐⭐ ⑤ 元数据**、**许可**与**窗口**（**含 **PubMed** 计**数**口径）****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**PubMed** 记录**逐字**给出 **PMID **`42711079`**、**日**期行 **`2026 Sep 8;16(9):e111600`**、**DOI **`10.1136/bmjopen-2025-111600`**、**PMCID **`PMC13560981`****、**`[Indexed for MEDLINE]`**、**许可**逐字 **`© Author(s) (or their employer(s)) 2026. Re-use permitted under CC BY-NC. No commercial re-use.`** 与**利**益**冲突**逐字 **`None declared`****；**⭐ 本词条**如实**指出**：**⭐ 即**本**轮**的「**窗口内」**判**定**用 **PubMed** 的 **`edat`（**入**库**日）**，**而**记录**里**的**出**版**日**期**行为 **`2026 Sep 8`****——**⭐ 二**者**在**本**条**上**一**致**，**但**在**本**轮**其**他**命中**上**曾**出**现**不**一致**（**逐字**如 **PMID **`42788379`** 的**日**期**行为 **`2026 Dec 31`** 而 **`edat`** 在**窗口内）**，**故**引用**要**写**明**用**的**是**哪**个**日期**；**⭐ 并**且**许**可 **`CC BY-NC`** 明**确**禁**止**商**业**再**用**（**⭐ 与**第 **378** 轮**记下的**「**非**商业**许可**要**随**数据**标注」**同**类）**。
**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[microinsurance-network]] 覆盖**微**型**保险**网络**、**[[who-gho]] 与 **[[worldbank-data]] 覆盖**全**球**卫生**与**发展**数据**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**用**全国**住户**调查**与**既有**方法**估**算**灾**难**性**医疗**支出**与**贫**困**化」这一**形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。
**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **阈**值**型**指标**要**多**档**并**排**；**② **按**分**布**形**状**选**连**接**函**数**（**log **link＋**gamma）**；**③ **把**发生率**与**财务**后果**分**开**报**；**④ **用**已**知**方**法**＋**公**开**数**据**＋**写**明**样本**；**⑤ **写**明**用**的**是**入**库**日**还**是**出**版**日**，**并**标**注**非**商业**许可**。
**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有阅读**其**正文**、**未**获**取**其**数**据**、**未**重**跑**其**任**何**估**算**，**故**不**主张**其**发**生**率**、**贫**困**化**估**计**或**因**果**解释**的**正确性**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**PubMed** 记录**接口**返回的**元数据与摘要**（**经 **E-utilities **`esummary`／**`efetch`）**，**未读**其**全文**（**⭐ 该**文**为**开**放**获取**，**本**词条**未**下**载）。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**阈**值**定**义**与 **Wagstaff **- **Doorslaer** 方**法**的**具**体**实**现**细**节**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其 **`14 395 households`** 与**分**区**样**本**的**抽**样**设**计**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**贫**困**线**与**购**买**力**平**价**口**径**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核实**其**结**论**是**否**被**任**何**政**策**文件**引**用**。**⑦ ⚠️ 窗口**状况**：**出**版**日 **2026-09-08** 与 **`edat`** 均**落在**本轮**窗口**之内**（**基准日 **2026-09-27）**，**故**无需**缺口**说明**；**⚠️ 该**文**许**可 **`CC BY-NC`**，**禁**止**商**业**再**用**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-27 所见**；**⚠️ 涉**及**医**疗**融**资**与**社**保**政**策**，**⚠️ 不**构成**任何**政**策**、**投**资**或**精**算**意见**。
e.verified_note: 实测核实（2026-09-27）：① PubMed E-utilities 检索 https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi?db=pubmed&term=catastrophic+health+expenditure&mindate=2026/09/05&maxdate=2026/09/25&datetype=edat&retmode=json 返回 200，count 6，本条 PMID 42711079 在其中 ② esummary 逐字：title Catastrophic health expenditures and medical impoverishment in Bangladesh: evidence from the Household Income and Expenditure Survey、pubdate 2026 Sep 8、source BMJ Open、authors Sarker AR, Islam R, Tran-Duy A、elocationid doi: 10.1136/bmjopen-2025-111600、pmcid PMC13560981 ③ efetch（rettype=abstract, retmode=text）返回 200，逐字含 BMJ Open. 2026 Sep 8;16(9):e111600. doi: 10.1136/bmjopen-2025-111600. 与 OBJECTIVES: Catastrophic health expenditure (CHE) and impoverishment due to out-of-pocket (OOP) expenditure are the most widely used metrics to assess financial protection in health. 与 DESIGN: A national cross-sectional survey. 与 PARTICIPANTS: 14 395 households from eight administrative divisions in Bangladesh. 与 The well-known methodology developed by Wagstaff and Doorslaer was used in this study to estimate the prevalence of CHE and the effect of OOP spending on impoverishment. We used a generalised linear model with a log link and a gam ma distribution to assess the association between the explanatory variables and annual OOP expenditure. 与 RESULTS: The prevalence of CHE was estimated to be 17.72% (95% CI 17.71% to 17.73%) and 7.07% (95% CI 7.06% to 7.08%) using 10% and 25% of the total consumption expenditure as thresholds, respectively. Given the 40% of non-food expenditure threshold level, about 9.46% (95% CI 9.45% to 9.47%) of households faced CHE due to OOP expenditure in Bangladesh. In 2022, approximately 3.7% (95% CI 3.7% to 3.71%) of the population (6.13 million people) fell into poverty in Bangladesh. The prevalence of CHE was higher among male-headed households, larger families, households with elderly members, households with members suffering from chronic illnesses, those using hospital care and individuals in the poorest wealth quintiles. 与 CONCLUSIONS: Our study indicated that the financial burden due to OOP expenditure was substantial in Bangladesh. Findings stress the need for prepayment schemes such as national health insurance for safeguarding households against falling into poverty. 与 © Author(s) (or their employer(s)) 2026. Re-use permitted under CC BY-NC. No commercial re-use. See rights and permissions. Published by BMJ Group. 与 Conflict of interest statement: Competing interests: None declared. ④ ⭐ 本轮 PubMed 面的口径判据（如实记录）：本轮的窗口过滤使用 edat（Entrez 入库日），而记录中另有 pubdate（出版日期行）；本条两者一致（均为 2026 Sep 8 前后），但本轮另一条命中（PMID 42788379，Global Health Action）的日期行为 2026 Dec 31 而 edat 在窗口内，故引用时必须写明用哪个日期 ⑤ 原文在分布名处写为 gam ma（词内空格，疑为排版问题），本词条照录而不静默修正 ⑥ 本轮基准日说明：系统日期实测 2026-09-27，故窗口以其为基准 ｜⚠️ 未阅读其正文、未获取其数据、未重跑任何估算，不主张其发生率、贫困化估计与因果解释的正确性｜⚠️ 本次只读 PubMed 记录接口返回的元数据与摘要（经 E-utilities esummary／efetch），未读其全文（该文为开放获取，本词条未下载）｜⚠️ 未核实其阈值定义与 Wagstaff-Doorslaer 方法的具体实现细节｜⚠️ 未核实其 14 395 户与分区样本的抽样设计｜⚠️ 未核实其贫困线与购买力平价口径｜⚠️ 未核实其结论是否被任何政策文件引用｜⚠️ 窗口状况：出版日 2026-09-08 与 edat 均在本轮窗口之内（基准日 2026-09-27），故无需缺口说明；该文许可 CC BY-NC，禁止商业再用｜⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-27 所见；涉及医疗融资与社保政策，不构成任何政策、投资或精算意见
e.title_en: A paper that estimates catastrophic health expenditure from a national household survey: it applies the well-known methodology attributed to two authors for the prevalence of catastrophic expenditure and the impoverishing effect of out-of-pocket spending, fits a generalised linear model with a log link and a gamma distribution for annual out-of-pocket expenditure, and reports prevalence side by side at three thresholds together with the number of people pushed into poverty in the survey year.
e.title_hk: **一**篇**用**全**國**住**戶**調**查**估**算**「**災**難**性**醫**療**支**出」**的**論**文****：`catastrophic-health-expenditure-bangladesh`——**⭐ 逐字標題為**「**Catastrophic health expenditures and medical impoverishment in Bangladesh: evidence from the Household Income and Expenditure Survey**」**；**⭐ 它用逐字 `the well-known methodology developed by Wagstaff and Doorslaer` 估算 CHE**，**並逐字用 `a generalised linear model with a log link and a gamma distribution` 做回歸**；**⭐ 而它把三檔閾值並排報出**（**逐字 `17.72%`（**總消費 10%）／`7.07%`（**25%）／`9.46%`（**非食品 40%）**）**，**並逐字給出貧困化人數 `3.7%` of the population (`6.13 million people`)****
e.summary_en: This paper estimates catastrophic health expenditure and medical impoverishment from a national household survey, and its title names the survey as the evidence base. **Measured this round**: published on the eighth of September inside the window in a journal issue with a persistent identifier, a PubMed Central identifier, a non-commercial attribution licence, and no declared competing interests; the data are the latest national household income and expenditure survey, covering nearly fourteen and a half thousand households across eight administrative divisions; and the stated method applies a well-known approach attributed to two authors and fits a generalised linear model with a log link and a gamma distribution. **This round theme is a new surface in a health insurance line, and this entry helps fill one of the thinnest categories on the site.** **Four things are worth reading: it reports the same indicator side by side at three thresholds rather than choosing a flattering one, giving prevalence at ten per cent of total consumption expenditure, at twenty-five per cent, and at forty per cent of non-food expenditure, so the same phenomenon differs by more than a factor of two depending on the threshold, which means any ratio-type indicator should be reported across thresholds rather than at a single cut, in the same family as the earlier practice of declaring an unestimable parameter over a grid; its choice of regression distribution is deliberate, since annual out-of-pocket spending is right skewed, non-negative, and continuous, making a log link with a gamma distribution the conventional configuration in insurance and health economics; it reports two distinct consequences, namely how many households face catastrophic expenditure and how many people are pushed into poverty, since how many people face catastrophic costs and how many are impoverished by them are different questions and insurance policy usually cares about the second; and its conclusion lands on prepayment, stating that findings stress the need for prepayment schemes such as national health insurance to safeguard households from falling into poverty.** **The paper text was not read and its estimates were not recomputed this round.**

This paper estimates catastrophic health expenditure and medical impoverishment from a national household survey. **This entry belongs to the round theme of a new surface in a health insurance line.**
**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-27 from the PubMed utilities**:
**First, it reports the same indicator side by side at three thresholds rather than choosing a flattering one.** The abstract estimates prevalence at about seventeen and seven tenths per cent using ten per cent of total consumption expenditure as the threshold, at about seven per cent using twenty-five per cent, and at about nine and a half per cent of households using forty per cent of non-food expenditure, with confidence intervals for each. **Catastrophic expenditure prevalence is therefore entirely a function of the threshold, differing by more than a factor of two across the three, so any threshold-type or ratio-type indicator should be reported across thresholds rather than at a single cut, in the same family as the earlier practice of declaring an unestimable parameter over a grid.**
**Second, its choice of regression distribution is deliberate and conventional in this field.** The abstract states that a generalised linear model with a log link and a gamma distribution was used to relate explanatory variables to annual out-of-pocket expenditure, and the record text contains a space inside the distribution name, which this entry reproduces rather than silently correcting. **Annual out-of-pocket spending is right skewed, non-negative, and continuous, so a log link with a gamma distribution reconciles multiplicative effects with a positive support, and the general practice is to look at the shape of the distribution before choosing a link function.**
**Third, it reports prevalence and impoverishment as two distinct consequences.** The abstract states that in the survey year approximately three and seven tenths per cent of the population, more than six million people, fell into poverty, and it lists who faces higher prevalence, namely male-headed households, larger families, households with elderly members, households with chronic illness, those using hospital care, and individuals in the poorest wealth quintiles. **How many households face catastrophic costs and how many people are impoverished by them are different questions, and policy and social protection research usually care about the second, while the first is an intermediate indicator of risk sharing.**
**Fourth, its method and data are stated precisely enough to trace.** The abstract names a well-known methodology attributed to two authors for estimating prevalence and the impoverishing effect, uses the latest national household income and expenditure survey, names nearly fourteen and a half thousand households across eight administrative divisions, and states that the design is a national cross-sectional survey. **Using an established method, a public survey, and an explicit sample description is what makes such a health financing estimate traceable and recomputable, though it was not recomputed here.**
**Fifth, metadata, licence, and window status, including a counting convention for this surface.** The record gives an identifier, a date line, a persistent identifier, a PubMed Central identifier, a MEDLINE indexing note, a non-commercial attribution licence that explicitly prohibits commercial reuse, and a statement of no competing interests. **This round judged the window by the entry date while the record also carries a publication date line, and although the two agree here, another in-window hit carried a publication date line far in the future with an entry date inside the window, so citations should state which date is used and should carry the non-commercial licence restriction.**
**Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover a microinsurance network and global health and development data sources, **while this entry supplies the form of a national household survey estimate of catastrophic health expenditure and impoverishment using an established method. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**
**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: report threshold-type indicators across several thresholds; choose the link function from the shape of the distribution; report incidence and financial consequence separately; combine an established method with public data and an explicit sample; and state which date is used together with any non-commercial licence term.**
**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the paper text was not read, its data were not obtained, and no estimate was recomputed**, so no claim is made about the correctness of the prevalence figures, the impoverishment estimate, or the causal interpretation. **Second, only metadata and abstract returned by the record interface were read**, not the full text, which is open access and was not downloaded here. **Third, the threshold definitions and the specific implementation of the attributed method were not verified. Fourth, the sampling design behind the stated household count and divisions was not verified. Fifth, the poverty line and purchasing power parity conventions were not verified. Sixth, whether the conclusions are cited in any policy document was not verified. Seventh, the publication date and the entry date both fall inside this round window against a baseline of the twenty-seventh of September, and the article carries a non-commercial licence prohibiting commercial reuse. Eighth, this entry records what was visible on that date and states plainly that it constitutes no policy, investment, or actuarial opinion.**

**Catastrophic health expenditures and medical impoverishment in Bangladesh**（PMID `42711079`；*BMJ Open* 2026;16(9):e111600）**是一篇**用**全國**住戶**調查**估**算**「**災**難**性**醫療**支出」**的**論文****——**逐字標題**為**「**Catastrophic health expenditures and medical impoverishment in Bangladesh: evidence from the Household Income and Expenditure Survey**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**新面 PubMed（**健康保險線）**」**。
**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-27 PubMed E-utilities 實測）**：
**⭐⭐⭐ ① 同一指標在三檔閾值下並排報出**——**逐字**The prevalence of CHE was estimated to be 17.72% (95% CI 17.71% to 17.73%) and 7.07% (95% CI 7.06% to 7.08%) using 10% and 25% of the total consumption expenditure as thresholds, respectively. Given the 40% of non-food expenditure threshold level, about 9.46% (95% CI 9.45% to 9.47%) of households faced CHE due to OOP expenditure in Bangladesh.**；**⭐ 即**閾值型指標要看口徑敏感性**，**多檔並排**。
**⭐⭐ ② 回歸分布選擇有講究**——**逐字**We used a generalised linear model with a log link and a gam ma distribution to assess the association between the explanatory variables and annual OOP expenditure.**（**⭐ 原文此處為 `gam ma`，**即排版時的詞內空格，**本條照錄而不靜默修正）**；**⭐ 即**年度自付支出右偏、**非負、**連續**，**log link＋**gamma 是常規配置**。
**⭐⭐ ③ 同時報發生率與貧困化**——**逐字**In 2022, approximately 3.7% (95% CI 3.7% to 3.71%) of the population (6.13 million people) fell into poverty in Bangladesh.** 與 **The prevalence of CHE was higher among male-headed households, larger families, households with elderly members, households with members suffering from chronic illnesses, those using hospital care and individuals in the poorest wealth quintiles.**；**⭐ 即**發生率與財務後果是兩件事**，**政策關心後者**。
**⭐⭐ ④ 方法與數據逐字可追**——**逐字**The well-known methodology developed by Wagstaff and Doorslaer was used in this study to estimate the prevalence of CHE and the effect of OOP spending on impoverishment.** 與 **We used data from the latest Household Income and Expenditure Survey 2022 in Bangladesh.** 與 **14 395 households from eight administrative divisions in Bangladesh.** 與 **A national cross-sectional survey**。
**⭐⭐ ⑤ 元資料、**許可與**窗口**——** PMID `42711079`、**日期行 `2026 Sep 8;16(9):e111600`、**DOI `10.1136/bmjopen-2025-111600`、**PMCID `PMC13560981`、**許可逐字 `Re-use permitted under CC BY-NC. No commercial re-use.`**、**利益衝突 `None declared`**；**⭐ 即**本輪以 edat 判定窗口**，**而日期行可不同（**本輪另有 PMID 42788379 日期行為 2026 Dec 31 而 edat 在窗口內）**。
**⭐⭐ ⑥ 與池內條目的關係**：[[microinsurance-network]]、[[who-gho]]、[[worldbank-data]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**用全國住戶調查與既有方法估算災難性醫療支出與貧困化**」**這一形態**。
**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **閾值型指標多檔並排**；**② **按分布形狀選連接函數**；**③ **發生率與財務後果分開報**；**④ **已知方法＋**公開數據＋**寫明樣本**；**⑤ **寫明用哪個日期並標註非商業許可**。
